title.narrative: Providing health aid to those affected by the Syrian earthquake

description.narrative: Filling the great shortage of medicines and medical devices in hospitals and health centers in the Syrian Republic, and helping to alleviate the suffering of our affected Syrian brothers.

Providing assistance to earthquake-affected people regarding the health aspect in the Syrian Republic. Providing health aid as support to the Association of Victims of Wars and Disasters in the Syrian Republic. Supporting the Association of Victims of Wars and Disasters with medical devices and medicines.
Providing means of assistance in the health sector with medicines, medical devices and supplies, which helps alleviate the deficit in hospitals and health centers in the Syrian Republic.
